elements.name: Cancel component selection for a drawing layout

steps.name: the active document is `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenPart.opd` in the MCAD Software
the new-document template chooser is open
`fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/Populated Layout.odd` is available as the populated inch assembly layout
the user selects the inch drawing template
the chooser displays the template sheet and available layout previews
the user selects the populated assembly layout preview
the user chooses Create
the template chooser closes
a component-selection dialog opens for a drawing view
the dialog displays a document name field and a browse control
it offers OK and Cancel
the user cancels component selection
the component-selection dialog closes
the original part document remains active
no new drawing tab is displayed

elements.name: Cancel component selection for a drawing layout

steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate.opj` as its active project

elements.name: Cancel browsing for a drawing-layout component

steps.name: a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/layout-data/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is active
the active part has been updated and then edited so that it needs updating again
`fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/Populated Layout.odd` is available as a drawing layout with a view and parts list
the user selects the assembly layout and opens its component-selection dialog
the dialog displays the active part
the user chooses Browse beside the document name
a file-selection dialog opens above component selection
it displays a folder and file list, a file name field and a file-type filter
it displays a preview area and Open and Cancel controls
the user cancels the file-selection dialog
the component-selection dialog is displayed again
its previous document name remains displayed
the user cancels component selection
the original document remains active
no new drawing tab is displayed

elements.name: Cancel browsing for a drawing-layout component

steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate.opj` as its active project
